subject: Implementation kickoff: OncoHealth tenant & API key plan
messages:
From: Alice Wong <alice.wong@oncohealth.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 11 Apr 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Kickoff: OncoHealth Redwood setup

Hi David (and Monica),

Thanks for the intro — excited to get started. We’d like to stand up a sandbox tenant and a production tenant for OncoHealth. High-level asks:
- Two projects (sandbox + prod) with separate API keys
- Admin seats for our infra lead (infra+security) and product manager
- Service account for backend inference calls (long-lived key)
- KMS integration: we manage keys in AWS KMS (account details below)

Can you confirm what you’ll need from our side (emails for invites, IAM mapping for roles, SLA for key rotation)? Also please share a proposed timeline and any onboarding checklist. I’ve attached a short org_requirements.xlsx with our contact list.

Best,
Alice
Alice Wong
Head of Platform Engineering, OncoHealth
alice.wong@oncohealth.com

Attachments: org_requirements.xlsx (spreadsheet, 48KB)

From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Wong <alice.wong@oncohealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 11 Apr 2025 11:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: OncoHealth Redwood setup

Hi Alice — thanks, and great to meet you virtually. Quick response and a proposed plan below. I’m copying our Implementation lead (Ben) and CS lead (Monica) so we can coordinate the handoff.

What we need from OncoHealth right away:
- Admin invite emails (list of 2): preferred login email(s) for the two admin seats
- AWS KMS account ID + key alias you want us to use for envelope encryption
- Project names you’d like visible in the Console (suggestions below)

Proposed minimal plan (3 phases, ~2 weeks to sandbox + config):
1) Kickoff call (30m) — confirm project names, roles, and rotation policy (this week)
2) Sandbox tenant live — we seed sandbox project, create service account, and provide API key template for rotation testing (3 business days)
3) Prod readiness — apply KMS binding, provision production API key material, run smoke tests, and hand over runbook (remaining week)

I’ve attached our onboarding checklist (onco_onboarding_checklist.pdf) and an API key csv template (api_key_template.csv) to speed seed. Proposed kickoff times (PDT): Mon 4/14 10:00, Mon 4/14 14:00, Tue 4/15 09:30 — which works for you?

Notes about KMS: we support BYOK via AWS KMS; we will need an IAM role ARN we can assume that has permission to encrypt/decrypt. If you prefer storing keys in Redwood-managed KMS, we can discuss tradeoffs on the call.

Next steps for us (internal): Ben will create the initial sandbox project and seed keys; Monica will run the kickoff and handoff checklist.

Thanks,
David
David Kim
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
david.kim@redwood.ai

Attachments: onco_onboarding_checklist.pdf; api_key_template.csv

Folks — forwarding Alice’s request and my reply. Short internal checklist I want us to cover before the kickoff: 

- Ben: create sandbox project "OncoHealth-Sandbox" and pre-seed a service account (service-onco-sbx) with a throwaway key for smoke tests. Upload key template to the shared drive link below.
- Ben: prepare a short demo showing key rotation using the api_key_template.csv (2-3 steps).
- Monica: schedule the kickoff (30m) and own the mutual action plan doc. I’ll include you on the HubSpot deal and add the timeline.
- Compliance: confirm that log retention for the sandbox is 30 days, prod 365 days — flag any hard stops to Alice.

Also, on KMS assume-role: request the IAM role ARN from Alice during the kickoff. If they push back, we’ll propose Redwood-managed KMS as the fallback.

Thanks for confirming, Alice — Monday 4/14 at 10:00 PDT is on the calendar (invite sent). Recap of what we’ll deliver in the first 7 business days post-kickoff:

Mutual action plan (brief):
- Day 0 (kickoff call): collect admin emails, IAM role ARN for KMS, and confirm project naming
- Day 1–3: sandbox project creation, service account, seed API key, run smoke tests
- Day 4–7: KMS binding for prod (if BYOK), prod API key issuance, runbook handoff + rotation steps

Immediate asks for you before the call:
1) Admin emails for invites (2 names)
2) AWS account ID and preferred KMS key alias (if BYOK)
3) Any IP allowlist entries for your CI/CD that should be added for the sandbox key

We’ve attached the onboarding checklist and the API key csv again for convenience. I’ll post the demo recording and seed artifacts to the Drive folder after the sandbox smoke test. If any of these items are blockers please flag them on the kickoff — we’ll be prepared with Redwood-managed KMS as a fallback.

Looking forward — talk Monday.

Best,
David
